dialogues.jp:
遅い朝食を食べ、居間でまったりテレビを観る。
日曜の昼間のテレビは、実にくだらない。
dialogues.en:
I had a late breakfast and watched TV in the living room.
Daytime TV shows on Sundays are truly boring.
dialogues.text:
I had a late breakfast and watched TV in the living room.
Daytime TV shows on Sundays are truly boring.

dialogues.jp:
（こんなものを流すぐらいなら、試験放送でも
　流せっての。そうしたら、こっちも諦めがつ
　いて他のことするから）
dialogues.en:
(If they're going to show something like this, they might as
well run the test broadcast or something. That way, I'll
just give up and find something else to do.)
dialogues.text:
(If they're going to show something like this, they might as
well run the test broadcast or something. That way, I'll
just give up and find something else to do.)

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを思ってみるが、本当にそんなこと
になったら……。
dialogues.en:
I thought about it for a while, but what if they really did
something like that......?
dialogues.text:
I thought about it for a while, but what if they really did
something like that......?

dialogues.jp: （結構、ウケるかも……）
dialogues.en: (It might be pretty funny......)
dialogues.text: (It might be pretty funny......)

dialogues.jp: もっとも、最初だけだろうが。
dialogues.en: But just for the first few times......
dialogues.text: But just for the first few times......

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……暇だ……」
dialogues.en: "Hah...... I'm bored......"
dialogues.text: "Hah...... I'm bored......"

dialogues.jp:
リモコンをテーブルに投げ出し、ソファーの背
もたれに、どっぷりともたれかかる。
dialogues.en:
I threw the remote on the table and sunk my body into the
couch.
dialogues.text:
I threw the remote on the table and sunk my body into the
couch.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
洗い物を終えた萌先輩が台所から出てきて、俺
の隣にフワリと腰かける。
dialogues.en:
After she finished washing dishes, Moe-sempai came out from
the kitchen and sat beside me.
dialogues.text:
After she finished washing dishes, Moe-sempai came out from
the kitchen and sat beside me.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、日曜はどうして、こうくだらない番組
　ばっかなんだろう……とか、早く試験放送始
　まらないかな……とか」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking how boring the TV shows are on Sundays......
And then I was thinking about the test broadcasting
system......"
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking how boring the TV shows are on Sundays......
And then I was thinking about the test broadcasting
system......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でしたら、これから出かけませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, would you like to go somewhere with me?"
dialogues.text: "Well, would you like to go somewhere with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「デートです」
dialogues.en: "Can we go out on a date?"
dialogues.text: "Can we go out on a date?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「で、デート……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Go out on a date......?"
dialogues.text: "Go out on a date......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 楽しげにニッコリと微笑む萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She smiled softly with joy.
dialogues.text: She smiled softly with joy.

dialogues.jp: デート……か。
dialogues.en: Date...... huh?
dialogues.text: Date...... huh?

dialogues.jp:
その……昨日のことと順番は逆になってしまっ
たが、確かにデートもしてみたい。
dialogues.en:
I'd like to go on a date with her, even though we did
something far more than that last night......
dialogues.text:
I'd like to go on a date with her, even though we did
something far more than that last night......

dialogues.jp:
「いいですね。どこに行きましょうか？　まぁ、
　この時間からじゃ、あんまり遠出は出来ない
　けど」
dialogues.en:
"That sounds good. Where do you want to go? It's too late to
travel too far though......"
dialogues.text:
"That sounds good. Where do you want to go? It's too late to
travel too far though......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「分かりました。それじゃあ、朝倉くんの足に
　負担がかからない所にしますね」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. Let's go somewhere that won't put too much pressure
on your leg."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. Let's go somewhere that won't put too much pressure
on your leg."

dialogues.jp:
先輩の手に引っ張られるようにして、ソファー
から立ち上がると、その手に導かれるまま、日
の傾き始めた住宅街を歩いた。
dialogues.en:
She pulled me up from the couch, and we started on a late
afternoon walk in the neighborhood.
dialogues.text:
She pulled me up from the couch, and we started on a late
afternoon walk in the neighborhood.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「着きました」
dialogues.en: "We're here."
dialogues.text: "We're here."

dialogues.jp: 楽しそうに微笑む萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Moe smiled joyfully.
dialogues.text: Moe smiled joyfully.

dialogues.jp: 「ここでいいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "This is it?"
dialogues.text: "This is it?"

dialogues.jp: 別に買い物とかでもよかったんだけど。
dialogues.en: We could have gone shopping or something.
dialogues.text: We could have gone shopping or something.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
俺の問いに、萌先輩の純真な笑顔が返ってくる。
なんとも萌先輩らしい。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai answered my question with her usual innocent
smile.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai answered my question with her usual innocent
smile.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、歩きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go for a walk?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go for a walk?"

dialogues.jp:
別に散歩の趣味があるわけでもないけど、恋人
と一緒なら、それも悪くはない。
dialogues.en:
I'm not into walking, but it's not too bad to walk with my
girlfriend.
dialogues.text:
I'm not into walking, but it's not too bad to walk with my
girlfriend.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、お昼寝をしましょう」
dialogues.en: "No, let's take a nap."
dialogues.text: "No, let's take a nap."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩が、一歩踏み出した俺を
呼び止める。
dialogues.en: Moe stopped me with a smile as I took one step.
dialogues.text: Moe stopped me with a smile as I took one step.

dialogues.jp: そのまま、芝生の上に仰向けに寝転がった。
dialogues.en: She lay down on the grass.
dialogues.text: She lay down on the grass.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「スー」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「早っ！」
dialogues.en: "Already?"
dialogues.text: "Already?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の“かったるい”を｛はる／遥｝かに上回るスピードで、
萌先輩は眠っていた。
dialogues.en: She was asleep in the blink of an eye.
dialogues.text: She was asleep in the blink of an eye.

dialogues.jp: 「本当に眠っちゃったの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you really sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Are you really sleeping?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の頭の横にしゃがみ込み、顔を覗き込む。
dialogues.en: I squatted near her head and looked into her face.
dialogues.text: I squatted near her head and looked into her face.

dialogues.jp: 「萌せんぱ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Moe-sempa~i?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Moe-sempa~i?"

dialogues.jp:
そっと呼びかけてみるが、反応なし。寝息だけ
が規則正しく聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
I called her quietly, but she didn't reply. All I can hear
was her periodic snoring.
dialogues.text:
I called her quietly, but she didn't reply. All I can hear
was her periodic snoring.

dialogues.jp: ここでいったい、俺に何をしろと？
dialogues.en: What am I supposed to do here?
dialogues.text: What am I supposed to do here?

dialogues.jp:
心地よい春風が、萌先輩の前髪を微かに揺らし
ている。
dialogues.en:
The comfortable spring breeze was blowing Moe-sempai's
bangs.
dialogues.text:
The comfortable spring breeze was blowing Moe-sempai's
bangs.

dialogues.jp: うららかな春の日に相応しい、安らかな寝顔だ。
dialogues.en:
Her moist lips were closed, and her breasts were moving up
and down with her rhythmic breathing.
dialogues.text:
Her moist lips were closed, and her breasts were moving up
and down with her rhythmic breathing.

dialogues.jp:
ほんのりと湿った唇は軽く閉じ合わされ、規則
正しい寝息に合わせて胸が静かに上下している。
dialogues.en:
Her luscious thighs were exposed from her skirt, as well as
her silky legs.
dialogues.text:
Her luscious thighs were exposed from her skirt, as well as
her silky legs.

dialogues.jp:
スカートの｛すそ／裾｝からは白い太股が顔を出し、｛つや／艶｝や
かな素足がのびている。

dialogues.en: I hear someone's laughter from afar......
dialogues.text: I hear someone's laughter from afar......

dialogues.jp: 少し離れた所から、楽しげな叫び声が聞こえる。
「ま、いっか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh well......"
dialogues.text: "Oh well......"

dialogues.jp:
俺は萌先輩の横に同じように仰向けに寝転がる
と、目の前に広がる青い空を眺めた。
dialogues.en:
I lay beside Moe-sempai, and looked at the broad blues sky
in front of me.
dialogues.text:
I lay beside Moe-sempai, and looked at the broad blues sky
in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
頬を撫でる、ふわっとした春風に運ばれて、白
い雲がのんびりと流れていく。
dialogues.en:
White clouds were moving slowly as they were blown by the
spring breeze.
dialogues.text:
White clouds were moving slowly as they were blown by the
spring breeze.

dialogues.jp:
なかなか変化しない空に飽きると、俺も｛まぶた／瞼｝を閉
じた……。
dialogues.en:
As I became more bored with the never-changing sky, I
decided to close my eyes......
dialogues.text:
As I became more bored with the never-changing sky, I
decided to close my eyes......

dialogues.jp: ◆デート◆
dialogues.en: ◆A date◆
dialogues.text: ◆A date◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が、デートに誘ってきた。
dialogues.en: Moe asked me out on a date.
dialogues.text: Moe asked me out on a date.

dialogues.jp:
着いた先で何をするのかと思いきや、速攻で昼
寝をされてしまった。
dialogues.en: When we got to the park, she fell asleep immediately.
dialogues.text: When we got to the park, she fell asleep immediately.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、いいか。そんな言葉を呟いて、俺も、萌
先輩の隣にごろっと横になったのだった。
dialogues.en: Oh well. I muttered and lay down beside her.
dialogues.text: Oh well. I muttered and lay down beside her.
